disambiguation: Not a general note encryption tool; it specifically encrypt code blocks within notes.
extras: Passwords cannot be recovered. If you forget the password, the ciphertext cannot be restored.
intentEvidence: Encrypt and preview editable secret code blocks.
problem: Users need a secure way to store sensitive or private information within their Obsidian notes without exposing the content in plain text.
summary: Secret Notes allows users to save private content in Obsidian by encrypting code blocks locally using a password, rendering them as clickable secret cards.
